# Dunnville Heating & Cooling

> Serving Dunnville and the wider Brant/Haldimand-Norfolk region, Dunnville Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (365) 661-7242  |  Email: contact@dunnvilleheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://dunnvilleheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Dunnville, Brantford, Paris, Caledonia, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Ayr, Aylmer
